source: TL2 summaries of public reporting; each item links to its source.

items.headline: Rising Treasury yields raise the cost of the AI buildout
items.line: CNBC reports that the jump in bond yields is making debt more expensive for data center and AI infrastructure companies that borrow heavily to build.

items.headline: Anthropic ships Sonnet 5.5 at the same list price
items.line: Anthropic says the new mid-tier model runs faster and costs less to operate than Sonnet 5; Simon Willison's first-look notes are at the link.

items.headline: Personal-agent startup Instinct raises $1 billion
items.line: TechCrunch reports the Series C values the company at $10 billion.
